title: leptogramma pozoi subsp. mollissima
intro: Leptogramma pozoi subsp. mollissima, commonly known as the soft-leaved Leptogramma, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Leptogramma pozoi subsp. mollissima include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and display antimicrobial activities. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
